limitations: Lv1 single-room 8-second scripted input component simulation; three heroes only.
Real source Player/Enemy/Actor/Floor/ImpactClock used, but actor construction, GLB/DOM/audio/frame performance, loot, entire floors, network parties, and long-run balance are outside scope.
All spawned enemies are skel_minion or elite_skel_captain, neither has mobRole. Mixed-role/common melee-slot pressure is not measured.
Same seed/hero/fps input pairing does not guarantee identical crit/random event streams after behavior branches diverge.
Baseline mode omits candidate alive/light-interruption/gather thresholds; both criteria counts are reported separately.
These scripted inputs do not test neutral backstep or intentional perfect-dodge feel.
